title: BARMM cops, family condemn killing of police major in Kidapawan

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR) condemned the killing of a police major in Kidapawan City on Monday, with his grieving family calling for a thorough investigation to give justice to his death. Major Razul Guiambangan Pandulo was gunned down inside his boarding house in Bolong Subdivision, Kidapawan City, at around 4:30 p.m. “Such a reprehensible attack against a police officer is an affront to the rule of law and will not be taken lightly,” Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, PRO-BAR regional director, said in a statement on Tuesday. READ: Police captain shot dead inside Kidapawan boarding house […]...
